title: Omnichannel AI Handoff: Pass an AI Conversation to a Live Agent | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
An AI that answers texts and calls should not trap a customer who needs a person. The subject's Live agent handoff settings let the AI pass a conversation to a queue of people when the customer asks for one, is ready to buy, or is frustrated. A text lands in the Messaging inbox, a call rings the queue or books a callback after hours, and the agent starts from the AI assistant's summary.

In this video:
• Why the AI hands a conversation to a person
• Creating the handoff queue with business hours
• The subject's AI configuration and the Live agent handoff card: queue and conditions
• The three cases the AI hands off, and when it never does
• Where a handed-over text lands: the Messaging inbox
• What a call experiences: ringing the queue, holding, and an after-hours callback
• The AI assistant's summary banner and Review AI conversation
